query: What signals suggest an expense will be declined?

per_column.name: asset_type_category
per_column.rationale: Type of asset/expense (hardware, travel, cloud, software) is known at submission time and plausibly correlates with decline rates across categories; a legitimate external predictor derived from item metadata.

per_column.name: entry_origin
per_column.rationale: How the entry was created (asset registration, auto-generated, manual acquisition, etc.) is available before adjudication and may carry signal about scrutiny/decline likelihood; not a function of the outcome.

per_column.name: source_id_present
per_column.rationale: Whether a source_id was linked reflects data completeness/traceability at intake, plausibly associated with approval vs decline, and is knowable prior to the outcome.

per_column.name: processed_date_present
per_column.rationale: Presence of a processed_date is populated as part of processing/adjudication. It is only knowable after the outcome and is likely deterministically tied to whether/how the expense was resolved, constituting outcome leakage.

per_column.name: ci_specificity
per_column.rationale: Granularity of the configuration item reference (named model vs generic label) reflects documentation quality at submission and can plausibly predict decline; external to the outcome.

per_column.name: vendor_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor/brand of the purchase is known at intake and can plausibly correlate with decline rates (approved vendors vs others); a legitimate predictor, not a restatement of the focus.

judge.rationale: Five of six columns are legitimate, pre-outcome features engineered from item, source, documentation, and vendor metadata that plausibly carry signal about decline likelihood, adding leverage beyond the raw columns. processed_date_present is a leakage feature: a processed date is typically populated during/after adjudication, so it is not knowable before the outcome and likely encodes the outcome itself. As a set the added columns provide moderate genuine predictive value, but the presence of a leaky column and the correlational (not strongly causal) nature of the rest caps the utility.
